prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production pixel-art world interaction prop atlas for an original hopeful science-fantasy RPG. Rich crisp handcrafted pixel clusters, 3/4 overhead game view, upper-left daylight, dark charcoal outlines, aged copper/brass, weathered wood, teal accents, cream highlights. Match premium detailed RPG props, not simple shapes or vector icons. EXACT4columns×2rows,2048×1024, equal square cells. Genuine transparent RGBA background with empty alpha, no checkerboard drawn into image. Each whole prop isolated, generous20px margin, no source object crossing into another cell. No text, letters, logos, people, floor square, border or drop shadow.
Row1 left-to-right: (1) compact treasure chest with curved weathered walnut lid, teal metal straps, brass hinges and intricate amber crystal latch, believable grain and tiny wear, closed, readable silhouette; (2) small rugged metal salvage crate, oxidized copper corners, steel shell and blue energy-cell socket, no symbols or letters; (3) a leather-and-canvas provisions satchel resting on its folded strap, small bundled herbs and cloth-wrapped supplies peeking from side, green glass vial, readable sturdy bag; (4) waist-height ancient signal console, weathered ivory stone base with copper ribs, angled teal glass screen, amber lens and a tiny salvaged antenna, tactile complex machinery, not a plain green cube, grounded broad foot.
Row2 left-to-right: (5)(6)(7) THREE consecutive subtle animation frames of the EXACT SAME rest lantern. A warm large amber glass lantern suspended from a short carved wooden arm on a sturdy copper-braced tripod, small rolled travel blanket and kettle at its foot. No firepit. Same footprint, camera, proportions, hardware and position in every frame; only the small inner flame and glass brightness change, gently leaning left, upright, right. Do not move the stand, blanket, kettle, outer silhouette or crop between frames. A serene place to rest. (8) A shallow unfinished construction foundation about twice as wide as tall: one low course of pale weathered stone, short wooden formwork, stacked spare bricks, a builder's small plan board and mallet at one corner. Clearly a marked empty building site, NOT a completed wall, rope fence, full building or ruin. Center remains open dirt. Low grounded 3/4 overhead silhouette.
These objects will display at native54–90px high (foundation about180px wide), so include deliberate readable material planes rather than tiny photographic grain. Every object should feel from the same lovingly authored coastal reclaimed-world game.
